description: Elections Commission - K. A. Padmachandra, W. R. A. R. D. Ranasinghe and W. R. P. Kumara of the Kurunegala Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated member of the Sri Lanka Podujana Peramuna
reasoning: This gazette contains multiple notices under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance declaring that specific individuals have vacated their office as members of the Kurunegala Pradeshiya Sabha due to ceasing membership in a political party. This content directly relates to electoral processes and the status of elected officials, falling under the Elections category (Type 7) which covers electoral matters including vacating of offices and declarations by election officials.
